title: A test store's code runs are asked of the layout, as every store path is
request: The owner: run the full gate and fix what it finds.
spec: The store's rule (32.1): nothing in dclab_rnd/store joins a store path itself; layout.py builds every one, and tests/test_store.py checks the code for it.

decisions.decision: A method on the layout, not an exception in the check
decisions.why: the check keeps every store path in one place, so a name that climbs out is refused in one place

findings.defect: 36.6 joined a test store's code-runs folder by hand
findings.scenario: The full gate's test_store.py walks every store module for a path built on a layout's root.
findings.cause: runs_for wrote layout.root / "code_runs" when 36.6 isolated test stores from the real runs; the package's quick gate did not run test_store.py, which no changed file pointed to.
findings.fix: Layout.code_runs() builds the path; runs_for asks it.

outcome: Every store path is again built by the layout, and the full gate's store check passes.
lessons: A rule checked by reading the whole package's code is only run when that test is; a package gate that picks tests by changed files can miss it.
